name: feldkirchen
_about: Level 5 Feldkirchen: pale-blue daylight, soft green hills, cream and terracotta town frontage, and an open dust-grey square.
Build with scripts/build_layer_set.py. Draw order puts the square before the buildings standing on it.
All generations used gemini-3.1-flash-image, 4:1, 4K, without references. Sources and sidecars are in build/art/feldkirchen/.
No seam waivers, flattening or feathering. Earlier prompt versions and rejected generations are retained.
Cloud variant 1 duplicated the row. The first hill and floor prompts produced rectangular side regions; v2 removes those.
Town variants 1 and 3 had clipped buildings or unsupported feet. Variant 2 supplies a continuous garden wall beneath the skyline dips.
Far v2 variant 1 had a ghost ridge in the key; variant 3 failed the unfeathered seam test. Variant 2 is the keeper.
